routine.subtitle: Ultra-gentle pH 5.5 restorative wash
routine.what: A velvety non-foaming emulsion that sweeps away overnight cellular debris while preserving the skin's delicate acid mantle.
routine.why: Harsh morning cleansers strip essential barrier ceramides. This preserves hydration reserves ahead of daytime environmental exposure.
routine.when: Morning — First step upon waking.
routine.how: Dispense two pumps onto slightly damp skin. Massage in gentle outward circular sweeps for 45 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water.
routine.textureNote: Milky, silk-like fluid with a subtle natural chamomile aroma

routine.subtitle: Targeted vascular soothing formulation
routine.what: A concentrated multi-tier humectant serum designed to bind hydration across both stratum corneum and deeper epidermal layers.
routine.why: Calms reactive capillary dilation identified on the cheek contour during scan.
routine.when: Morning — Apply immediately after cleansing to damp skin.
routine.how: Press 3-4 drops gently across the face, neck, and décolletage. Pat lightly with fingertips rather than rubbing.
routine.textureNote: Lightweight water-gel that absorbs within seconds without stickiness

routine.subtitle: Biomimetic squalane & ceramide complex
routine.what: A featherweight barrier-reinforcing cream engineered to seal in water molecules while bolstering lipid resilience.
routine.why: Forms an invisible breathable matrix preventing daytime moisture evaporation and soothing localized cheek redness.
routine.when: Morning — Following treatment serums.
routine.how: Warm a dime-sized portion between warm fingertips, then gently press into the skin starting from the center of the face outwards.
routine.textureNote: Whipped cloud-like soufflé that melts upon contact

routine.productName: Mineral Fluid Shield Broad Spectrum SPF 50+
routine.subtitle: Invisible non-nano zinc with antioxidant ectoin
routine.what: An ethereal mineral shield defending against UVA/UVB, blue light, and oxidative pollution without chalkiness.
routine.why: Protects fragile newly hydrated cells and prevents the exacerbation of detected mild pigment clusters.
routine.when: Morning — Final step, at least 15 minutes prior to sun exposure.
routine.how: Apply two full finger-lengths evenly across face, ears, and neck. Reapply every two hours if outdoors.
routine.textureNote: Translucent satin fluid with zero white cast or greasy sheen

routine.subtitle: First cleanse lipid dissolution
routine.what: A sumptuous botanical oil that effortlessly dissolves SPF, airborne micro-particulates, and excess surface sebum.
routine.why: Prevents pore congestion in the T-Zone without triggering rebound oiliness.
routine.when: Evening — First step of two-phase evening purification.
routine.how: Massage dry onto dry skin for 60 seconds. Add a splash of warm water to transform into milk, then rinse thoroughly.
routine.textureNote: Silky golden nectar that emulsifies into a pure white veil

routine.subtitle: Encapsulated gentle cell turnover catalyst
routine.what: A gentle nightly corrective treatment accelerating cellular renewal, smoothing dermal texture, and clarifying subtle tone variance.
routine.why: Refines texture irregularities and minimizes subtle cheek erythema without inflammatory irritation.
routine.when: Evening — 3 to 4 evenings weekly on clean, dry skin.
routine.how: Dispense 1 dropper full. Smooth evenly avoiding the immediate eye contours. Allow 2 minutes to absorb before moisturizing.
routine.textureNote: Opalescent serum with a soothing herbal profile

routine.subtitle: Nocturnal physiological barrier recovery
routine.what: An intensive nightly cocoon that works in harmony with the body's natural circadian healing rhythms.
routine.why: Restores the epidermal lipid ratio while you sleep, waking to plumper, calmed, and visibly luminous skin.
routine.when: Evening — Final night ritual step.
routine.how: Smooth an almond-sized dollop over face and throat using upward lymphatic draining strokes.
routine.textureNote: Cushiony rich cream that envelops skin in continuous hydration
